about: Moods and broad genres for each song on John's Song of the Day. Each song gets up to two of ten moods, weighed up from Claude's picks (songs Claude knows or has read about, sound and lyrics), Last.fm listener tags, and Essentia's mood models listening to the 30-second preview (Music Technology Group, Universitat Pompeu Fabra, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). sound = the three moods the audio models hear most; listeners = whether Last.fm listeners' tags back the first mood; check = nothing firmer than a guess or the audio models, or listeners and audio both disagree with Claude. Genres come from MusicBrainz, Last.fm and Essentia's Discogs styles. John's corrections from the admin page always win.
